task_description.overview: Estimate the Gutenberg-Richter b-value from a catalog of earthquake magnitudes using a specified estimation algorithm.
steps: Import the desired estimator class (e.g., ClassicBValueEstimator, BPositiveBValueEstimator, BMorePositiveBValueEstimator, or UtsuBValueEstimator).
Call estimator.calculate(magnitudes, mc, delta_m[, times, dmc]) to compute the b-value. The method excludes magnitudes below the completeness threshold mc.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Compute the b-value with given catalog at {catalog_path}. Using the `seismostats` libarary to load the catalog, bin the magnitudes and estimate the magnitude of completeness. Then, calculate the b-value with the `seismostats.analysis.ClassicBValueEstimator` class. Report the b-value and plot a figure to show the b-value estimation (magnitude-frequency distribution and Gutenberg-Richter fit). 
 Note: 1) Save the b-value to {result_data.save name} with content {result_data.content} and the plot to {result_plot}.
